telemetry_and_redaction_implications.test_evidence: test_result_excludes_search_replace_markers and test_result_excludes_raw_replacement_content confirm output does not contain SEARCH/REPLACE markers or old_str/new_str.
telemetry_and_redaction_implications.no_new_telemetry_events: Bridge emits no new telemetry events. All telemetry is upstream in ToolRuntime.emit_governance_gate_decision().
telemetry_and_redaction_implications.no_new_redaction_paths: Bridge does not add or bypass redaction.

governance_seam_discovered.description: RuntimeToolRuntimeAdapter.build_policy() hardcodes permission denial for mutation tools. The ToolRuntime permission gate correctly returns REFUSED with refusal_reason='policy_object_missing'.
governance_seam_discovered.proven_by: All bridge mutation invocations reach the runtime path, pass through ToolRuntime.execute_one(), hit the permission gate, and receive a structured refusal with receipt identifiers.
governance_seam_discovered.bridge_behavior: The bridge does NOT bypass this policy. It correctly receives the refusal and returns content-light identifiers to OpenCode.
governance_seam_discovered.impact: search_replace, write_file, and bash cannot complete through the runtime adapter path until the adapter policy is expanded to wire actual governance.
governance_seam_discovered.recommendation: A future slice must expand RuntimeToolRuntimeAdapter.build_policy() to allow lawful mutation under appropriate governance. This is not Stage A scope.

stage_a_1_handoff_correlation.reason: Staged deletion of .opencode/plugins/rig-roadmap-steward.ts makes Steward ownership boundary contested. Defer until Steward state is clean.
stage_a_1_handoff_correlation.current_state: Bridge returns receipt_sha256 and receipt_envelope_id to OpenCode. OpenCode may use these for its own correlation.

stage_b_mutation_bypass_blocking: Block OpenCode built-in edit, write, apply_patch, bash
intentionally_deferred_work.runtime_adapter_policy_expansion: Expand RuntimeToolRuntimeAdapter.build_policy() to allow lawful mutation under governance. Bridge is proven ready — the block is in the adapter, not the bridge.

discovered_out_of_scope_risks: policy_object_missing is a fail-closed default in RuntimeToolRuntimeAdapter.build_policy(). No existing test exercises mutation completion through the runtime adapter path. The existing test_runtime_tool_invocation_execution.py tests for search_replace also fail with REFUSED — this was not detected during the audit because the full suite was not re-run.

worktree_path is required for mutation unless allow_main_repo_mutation=True. The bridge must set this flag when operating without a worktree — this flag bypasses mutation location policy but does not bypass the permission gate.
RuntimeSupervisorToolSubprocessRunner import may fail silently — this affects bash subprocess execution but not search_replace.
git_status, git_diff, grep are not in RuntimeToolName enum — wiring them requires expanding the runtime execution path.
